name: Zushi (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Zushi city emblem in white: a ring beneath a horizontal bar and above a curved base, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Zushi, a city in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 December 1950.

features.role: Zushi city emblem — a ring beneath a horizontal bar and above a curved base, like a stylised character
